CampaignDiagnosticsRequest.description: A request to run diagnostics to retrieve issues impacting campaigns.

campaignIdsList.description: A list of campaign identifiers to be diagnosed.

includeOnlyActive.description: Includes diagnostics information for only enabled entities. By default the response includes diagnostics information for both 'Enabled' and 'Paused' entities.

issueTypeFilter.description: Specifies the issue types to be included. By default the response will include all issue types.

locale.description: Specifies the language in which diagnostics information is returned. By default value is set to en_US. Value must be one of the following en_US, zh_CN, es_MX, es_ES, de_DE, fr_FR, it_IT, ja_JP, ko_KR, pt_BR, nl_NL, en_CA, fr_CA, en_GB, tr_TR, en_AE, ar_AE, en_AU, en_IN, hi_IN, ta_IN, ru_RU, en_SG, pl_PL, sv_SE, vi_VN, th_TH, es_CO, zh_TW

maxIssuesPerCampaign.description: Sets a limit on the number of issues returned for a campaign. Default value is set to 100 and maximum value supported is 1000.

nextToken.description: Operations that return paginated results include a pagination token in this field. To retrieve the next page of results, call the same operation and specify this token in the request. If the nextToken field is empty, there are no further results.

severityFilter.description: Specifies the issue severities to be included. By default the response will include all issue severities.

CampaignDiagnosticsResponse.description: A list of issues diagnosed for the campaigns specified by the requester.

campaignDiagnosticsList.description: A list of diagnosed campaigns with information on identified issues.

nextToken.description: Operations that return paginated results include a pagination token in this field. To retrieve the next page of results, call the same operation and specify this token in the request. If the nextToken field is empty, there are no further results.

errorMessage.example: Client is exceeding the request rate limits for an advertiser.
campaignIdsList was not contained in payload.

errorCode.description: Enum indicating the category of error. Example `NOT_FOUND`.

impact.description: Captures the impact of the issue across the campaign.

entityIdentifier.description: An Amazon product identifier or seller product identifier.

entityType.description: Field to mention the impacted entityType for the issue. Possible entityType values are 'ASIN' or 'SKU' and the value is based off the issueType value.

numAdsImpacted.description: A count of ads impacted by the entity.

supplementalInfo.description: Provides the corresponding ASIN information in case of seller product issue, reflected as 'SKU' in entityType.

information.description: A human readable description of the issue including possible remediations, wherever applicable.
information.example: Because we only allow ads from Featured Offer winners, this might be affecting the impressions for this ad. We select the Featured Offer based on multiple factors such as price, availability, delivery speed, and customer service.

issueCode.description: Describes the specific issue code under the broader issueType, for example MISSING_IMAGE.

IssueType.description: Describes the type of the issue, for example FEATURED OFFER, PRODUCT_ELIGIBILITY, MODERATION.

Severity.description: Describes the severity of the issue whether it is CRITICAL or WARNING.

campaignDiagnosticsList.description: A list of diagnosed campaigns with information on identified issues.

issuesList.description: A list of issues impacting the campaign.

info.title: Diagnostics

post.description:
Creates the advertiser campaign issues, for all advertising campaigns.

**Requires one of these permissions**:
["advertiser_campaign_view","advertiser_campaign_edit"]

parameters.description: The identifier of a client associated with a "Login with Amazon" account.
parameters.name: Amazon-Advertising-API-ClientId

parameters.description: The identifier of a profile associated with the advertiser account. Use `GET` method on Profiles resource to list profiles associated with the access token passed in the HTTP Authorization header and choose profile id `profileId` from the response to pass it as input.
parameters.name: Amazon-Advertising-API-Scope
